title: KMIPKit Public API Manifest
description: Version 2 describes the complete KMIPKit 1.0 public API. The registry-slice branch remains for generator fixture compatibility.

requirementId.description: Stable functional or success-criteria identifier from an approved KMIPKit feature specification.

requirementIds.description: Requirement identifiers are unique and lexicographically sorted.

values.description: Known symbolic names and numeric codes in deterministic declaration order. Each code fits the declared unsigned C storage type. The generator also checks that names and codes are individually unique. The shape and unknownValuePolicy jointly state whether unknown codes are preserved or rejected.

enumRepresentation.description: A numeric enum with an explicit list of known values and a policy matched to its open or closed shape.

errorCategoryIds.description: Each identifier must resolve to one errorCategories entry.

cCode.description: Stable C error-code name; status values use int32_t.

cValue.description: Explicit stable numeric value for the named int32_t C error code.

type.description: Pointer-to-pointer array of opaque C handles.

handleType.description: Opaque handle type of each array element; must match the declared pointer type.

countParameter.description: Name of the uint64_t scalar parameter that counts array elements.

nullable.description: Whether the array pointer may be NULL. When true, NULL is valid only when the linked count is zero; implementations must check the count before reading elements.

type.description: Pointer to one fixed-width integer result; not nullable.

nullable.description: Whether successful status may return no handle. Required explicitly for every output handle.

requestBoundary.description: States how the function relates to typed requests. Generic TTLV and raw bodies never cross the execute boundary.

parameters.description: Rust parameter names and types, in declaration order.

Parameter order is the exact C ABI order. Variable-length byte inputs are byte-span pointers paired with uint64_t byte lengths; handle arrays use explicit uint64_t element counts. Version 1 does not describe variable-length output buffers.

returnType.description: Every exported function returns a fixed-width status code; values and handles are written through explicit output parameters.

parameters.description: Java parameter names and types, in declaration order.
Python parameter names and types, in declaration order.

ordering.description: For repeatable extension attachment, declare preservation of caller-selected batch and extension order.

defaultDiagnostics.description: Logs, errors, and default debug/display representations exclude extension payloads and secrets. Do not include sample payloads in manifest text.

zeroization.description: Describe KMIPKit-owned secret-memory cleanup without including secret values.

generatedOutputs.description: The generator writes only these source and test destinations, in the property order above. Documentation remains handwritten under the plan's docs/ and language-package docs.

rustType.description: Rust type subset: identifier paths, one- or two-level generic applications with non-empty path arguments, Result<(), E> including a qualified Result path, unit and tuple types, fixed arrays, references, and borrowed slices.

javaType.description: Java parameter/type subset: primitive/simple or dot-qualified names, arrays, and one-level generic applications with non-empty reference-type arguments. Primitive and void arguments are not allowed; wildcards are unsupported.

javaReturnType.description: Java method result type: a javaType or void.

pythonType.description: Python 3 type subset: simple or dotted names, one-level subscripted generics (including tuple ellipsis), and PEP 604 unions.

limits.description: The twelve ExtensionRegistryLimits entries have fixed names, defaults, maxima, and order from FR-012. Each language maps the same logical limit to its declared field name.

formatVersion.description: The manifest data format version. Breaking field or meaning changes require a new version and schema identifier.

scope.description: This manifest covers the KMIPKIT-0012 registry surface only; it is not the complete KMIPKit 1.0 API inventory.

types.description: Type declarations are emitted in this array order.

functions.description: Function declarations and each function's parameters are emitted in their declared array order.

errorCategories.description: Stable cross-language error mappings. Entries are emitted in this array order.

limits.description: The twelve ExtensionRegistryLimits entries have fixed names, defaults, maxima, and order from FR-012. Each language maps the same logical limit to its declared field name.
